title: Paradigm Shift in Cosmology: Continuous Energy Recycling Through the Grid-Higgs Framework
abstract: The paper synthesizes the Energy-Flow (EFC) and Grid-Higgs frameworks to propose a cosmology with continuous energy recycling, reinterpreting the CMB as an ongoing process rather than a relic. It replaces dark matter with entropy-driven "entropic tension" between Higgs-anchored spacetime nodes and argues for near-standard behavior except at entropy extremes, offering quantitative, testable deviations in CMB anisotropies and lensing.
